About Cupcake Mama

Hi, I'm Marie — the baker behind Cupcake Mama. I specialize in custom cakes, stuffed cupcakes and edible favors that are designed around your colors, theme and budget.

Everything is baked from scratch from my home kitchen on the Freehold / Howell border, with layered cakes, rich mousses and fun fillings that make every slice and every cupcake feel like its own little celebration.

Our Creations

What I Offer

🎂 Layered Cakes

Available in 6", 8", 10" and 12" sizes with your choice of layers, fillings, and icing (vanilla buttercream or fudge). Custom toppers available from ARJcrafting to match your theme perfectly.

🧁 Stuffed Cupcakes

One cake flavor and one filling per 24 cupcakes, stuffed with mousse, fudge or fruit fillings so every cupcake feels like a mini layer cake. Custom toppers available from ARJcrafting.

🍭 Edible Favors & Platters

Hot chocolate bombs, cake pops, chocolate lollipops, dipped rice Krispy pops, dipped pretzels, dipped caramel pretzels, chocolate-covered strawberries, cakesicles, brownie platters, cookie & brownie platters and chocolate-dipped Oreos.

How Ordering Works

To keep everything fresh and custom, I work by pre-order only. Here's how the process works:

1

Send an Inquiry

Share your event date, type of event, location, approximate servings, flavors and theme. You can email me at cupcakemamamarie@gmail.com , text or call 732-766-6933 .

2

Get a Quote & Design Plan

I'll confirm availability, suggest sizes and flavors, and go over design ideas (colors, theme, style and budget).

3

Secure Your Date

A 50% non-refundable deposit via Venmo is required to hold your spot on the calendar.

4

Last-Minute Orders

Orders booked 10 days or less before the event require 100% non-refundable payment in advance via Venmo or Zelle.

5

Pickup or Delivery

Pickup is from my home kitchen near the Freehold / Howell border (exact address provided upon booking). Weekend orders are typically picked up Friday between 4–6 PM, or by arrangement the day/evening prior. Delivery is available for an additional fee when scheduled in advance.

💳

Payment Options

Secure your order with Venmo @Marie-Coloreo or Zelle 732-766-6933. A 50% deposit is required to hold your date. Last-minute orders (10 days or less) require 100% payment upfront.
